subject: Commit sprint — hygiene run / PO timing & invoicing dependencies
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: PO timing & invoice windows for July commit

Hi Priyom,

Quick note from finance as we close July bookings: we have a couple of large POs coming through (two scheduled contract signings next week) and need to confirm the invoice windows to ensure bookings flow into July recognition. Specifically: 

- Do you have a preferred PO arrival cutoff to guarantee July booking recognition?
- Are there any required PO metadata fields (billing contact, order number, billing address) that will delay invoice generation if missing?
- Can Redwood issue pro forma invoices ahead of PO finalization to avoid recognition gaps?

We want to avoid any missed recognition for our end-of-quarter numbers. I can share the PO samples if that helps. 

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Finance Manager, Kestrel Health
attachments: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO timing & invoice windows for July commit

Alicia — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: we can support an invoice issuance cadence that preserves July recognition, but there are a few gating items. Proposed plan below and attached a first-pass playbook (po_timing_playbook_v1.xlsx):

1) PO arrival cutoff: to guarantee July recognition on our side, PO must be received and acknowledged by Redwood by 2028-07-25 23:59 PT. If PO arrives after that, we can evaluate a late-window process but cannot promise July booking recognition.

2) Required PO metadata: minimal set needed to auto-generate invoices — billing contact email, purchase order number, legal entity name, billing address, and signed signature page. Missing any of these may require manual review (1–3 business days).

3) Pro forma option: we can issue a pro forma invoice tied to an executed SOW if Kestrel shares the signed contract plus a short email confirmation. Legal has to approve the pro forma wording (Ben, Laura — tagging you for a fast review path).

4) Edge cases / partial shipments: for multi-milestone deals, we will need explicit milestone acceptance dates to certify recognition.

Next steps: Marcus will share a gating matrix that maps common issues to mitigation steps so your AP team can submit cleaner POs. Can you share the two sample POs you mentioned? I’ll fast-track internal reviews assuming they look standard.

—Priyom
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: po_timing_playbook_v1.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@kestrelhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO timing & invoice windows for July commit

Adding the gating matrix (gating_matrix_q3.csv) — this is the condensed operational checklist our billing ops team uses when validating incoming POs. High level: 

- Green (auto-accept): all required metadata present, PO number matches contract, billing contact validated -> auto-invoice same day.
- Amber (manual review): one missing field or ambiguous legal name -> 24–72 hour ops review.
- Red (needs action): signature page missing or billing entity mismatch -> require counterparty confirmation, delays >72 hrs.

I also included a quick 'fast route' for pro forma approval (two internal approvals: Revenue Ops + Legal). Laura / Ben: can you confirm Legal will accept the pro forma template in the playbook? If yes, we can flip on pro forma issuance for Kestrel to avoid recognition slippage.

Sample rows from the matrix: PO sample id, required fields present, recommended handling, expected delay (hrs).

On process: if Kestrel can assign an AP single point-of-contact and send POs as PDFs (not scanned images), that alone eliminates >60% of manual review time.

—Marcus
Billing Ops Manager
attachments: gating_matrix_q3.csv
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO timing & invoice windows for July commit

Thanks, team — that helps a lot. A few clarifications from our AP side: 

- We will target sending signed POs by 2028-07-24 (aiming to hit your 07-25 cutoff).
- AP can provide a single POC (I will be the lead and will send a kickoff email with contact info).
- For the pro forma route: I need legal confirmation from our side that accepted wording is equivalent to an invoice for internal recognition. I’ll loop in our counsel if needed.

Attached is PO# KH-4512 (signed) and a draft PO pending a small billing address update (PO# KH-4513-draft). Please confirm whether KH-4512 is sufficient to trigger invoice generation if it passes your gating matrix.

We attached the two PO PDFs as separate messages to avoid scanning issues — please confirm receipt of the PDFs in-line or tell me if you prefer us to re-upload to the playbook sheet.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alicia
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO timing & invoice windows for July commit

Alicia — got both POs, thanks. Quick confirmation after running KH-4512 through the matrix: 

- KH-4512: GREEN — all required metadata present, matches contract reference, auto-invoice today (we will send invoice PDF to finance@kestrelhealth.com by EOD). This will be eligible for July booking recognition.
- KH-4513-draft: AMBER — billing address mismatch flagged; Marcus is assigning an ops reviewer and will ping your AP POC for the single-line correction. Expected manual review turnaround: 24 hours.

Ben / Laura: legal okay to fast-track the pro forma template from the playbook? If yes, we should enable it for the next large PO coming through next week to fully de-risk recognition.

Action items (owners):
- Alicia: Share final AP POC email and confirm delivery protocol (PDF vs upload to sheet). (owner: Alicia)
- Marcus: complete manual review for KH-4513-draft and confirm whether additional signatures are required. (owner: Marcus)
- Priyom: if pro forma gets legal OK, I’ll issue and tie to SOW reference. (owner: Priyom)

I’ll drop the playbook and matrix into the shared sheet now (link included in metadata). Thanks team — good hygiene will keep both sides aligned for recognition this month.

—Priyom
